message.reasoning_content:
Write a JSON persona card for a CIO. Constraints: no age, gender, ethnicity, nationality, politics, real org/product names, no numerical weights, no explicit ordering, no veto, no hard thresholds, no model reference. professional_background ≤80 words. decision_priorities 3-5 short phrases. risk_attitude one short statement. time_horizon one short statement. organizational_constraints 2-4 items.

Avoid words like "first", "primarily", "top priority" that imply ordering. Avoid "must" vetoes. Keep it plausible.
